description: The F-22 Raptor is a fifth-generation stealth air superiority fighter developed by Lockheed Martin for the United States Air Force. It was designed to achieve air dominance through advanced stealth technology, supercruise capability, high maneuverability, and sophisticated avionics. The aircraft can fly at supersonic speeds without using afterburners and is equipped with advanced radar and sensor systems that allow it to detect and engage enemy aircraft at long distances. Its combination of stealth, speed, and agility makes it one of the most advanced fighter jets ever built.

The Sukhoi Su-57 is Russia’s first fifth-generation stealth fighter aircraft developed by Sukhoi for the Russian Aerospace Forces. It is designed for air superiority and strike missions while incorporating stealth technology, advanced avionics, and supermaneuverability. The aircraft features a blended wing-body design and thrust-vectoring engines that allow extreme agility during aerial combat. The Su-57 also includes advanced radar systems and the ability to carry a wide variety of air-to-air and air-to-ground weapons internally to reduce radar detection.

The Dassault Rafale is a French twin-engine multirole fighter aircraft designed and built by Dassault Aviation. It features a delta wing configuration with canards that provide excellent maneuverability and stability during combat missions. Rafale is capable of performing a wide range of roles including air superiority, ground attack, reconnaissance, and nuclear deterrence. It is equipped with advanced avionics, radar systems, and electronic warfare capabilities, making it one of the most versatile fighter aircraft currently in service.

The Chengdu J-20 is a fifth-generation stealth fighter developed by China’s Chengdu Aerospace Corporation for the People’s Liberation Army Air Force. It is designed primarily for air superiority missions and features stealth shaping, advanced avionics, and long-range capabilities. The aircraft has a distinctive design with a long fuselage, stealth geometry, and canard control surfaces. Its internal weapon bays allow it to carry missiles while maintaining a low radar cross-section, making it suitable for modern aerial combat environments.

The B-2 Spirit is a strategic stealth bomber developed by Northrop Grumman for the United States Air Force. Unlike traditional fighter aircraft, the B-2 uses a flying wing design that significantly reduces radar visibility and allows it to penetrate heavily defended airspace. It is capable of carrying both conventional and nuclear weapons and can travel extremely long distances with aerial refueling. The aircraft plays a critical role in long-range strike missions and strategic deterrence.
